reason: All broad replacement stop heads failed v2 development guards; keep v1 stop head and evaluate bounded release-only correction before fresh validation
input_region: Only frames in the final 2s of a predicted dead run that has a predicted live successor, with the ball missing. Derived exclusively from frozen model predictions and observations.
features: Frozen dead log-odds; past/future mean player speed at 0.4 and 1.2s; past/future active-player fraction at 0.4s; future ball-observation fraction at 1.2s; time until predicted resume divided by 2s
fit: Natural-prevalence logistic regression on explicit external live/dead examples sampled at 5Hz in the observation-defined region; ridge 0.01 or 0.1; final refit training+selection. No parameter search on either held-out match.
action: Advance an existing predicted D->live boundary only after a consecutive 0.4s run of missing-ball observations with release model dead probability below threshold. Cap advance at selected limit. No new D is possible; no unbounded gap fill or action on terminal D runs. Recompute team path if the selected head resets on D.
selection: Include no-change baseline. Minimise missing-ball false-D rate at restart offsets 0.5,1,2s; tie maximise equal-scenario mean whole H/A/D accuracy, then prefer no change, larger ridge, shorter maximum advance and lower probability threshold.
guards: Each scenario: whole H/A/D accuracy >= base-v2-0.002, dead F1 >= base-v2-0.005, dead recall >= base-v2-0.01. Unknown labels masked. All selected parameters frozen before J03WR9 scoring.
fresh_evaluation: Use original v2 release gate without relaxing it. Primary candidate is v2 plus chosen refinement. Also report unrefined v2 as diagnostic; do not choose ablations after validation.
